description: Post a new run of an accepted saved contract with its latest accepted spec, checks, and price. Only attachments marked reused every run are copied unless carry_attachment_ids lists the ones to copy.

carry_attachment_ids.description: Attachments to copy from the latest accepted run. Omit to copy only the attachments marked reused every run.

funding_rail.description: balance pays the run from the agent's bounty balance at posting, so it is funded at once. Omit to fund it through the x402 fund_url.
